candidate_rule: two non-promoted candidates per record: verified official research fact or deterministic rounded-snapshot distribution metric, plus explicit scope guard

scope_guards.snapshot_scope: July 2026 BDUK values are rounded management-information rows limited to initial contract scope, with variable ingestion lag. They do not establish exact-address completion, current availability, orderability or contractual milestone compliance.
scope_guards.derived_distribution: Unbuilt counts, ratios, shares, ranks and comparisons are deterministic calculations over displayed rounded rows and displayed totals. They are not official statistics, forecasts, supplier-performance verdicts or parcel-level claims.
scope_guards.supplier_aggregate: Supplier totals and ranks are row-summed analytical groupings of the displayed July table. They can repeat across contracts belonging to the same supplier and do not represent contractual accounts, audited delivery or exact-address coverage.
scope_guards.network_research_scope: Connected Nations figures are aggregate estimates with defined reporting populations and methodologies. They do not predict availability, speed or eligibility at a particular address.
scope_guards.checker_scope: Map Your Mobile outputs are postcode or postal-district guidance based on predictions and measurements. Local experience can vary and checker results are not a service guarantee.
scope_guards.emergency_scope: The emergency-calls compliance material describes provider obligations and a closed regulatory programme. It is not legal advice and does not prove an individual service's resilience or caller-location performance.
